unit.unitinstructions:
You are being asked to participate in a research study.
The purpose of this research is to evaluate how individual factors (e.g., prior knowledge, anxiety level, need for cognition) influence the optimal difficulty level in the adaptive training of Chinese character components. You will experience three different difficulty levels of training and a posttest we will see which one is optimal considering individual factors.

You are being invited to participate because you are an experienced Amazon Turk worker. You will be one of 240 subjects to participate in the research.

Should you agree to participate you will be asked to finish the procedures below.

1. There are two parts in this experiment. The first part includes trainings about Chinese character components (about 1 hour). The second part happens 2-3 days later for the posttest (about 15-25 min of the same items being quizzed) and also hassome survey questions.

2. In the first part, there will be three 15 min training sessions with different difficulty levels about Chinese character components. In each session, you will be asked to read and answer fill-in-the-blank items. Given a Chinese character component, type the corresponding English meaning. Please answer all the items to the best of your ability based on your current knowledge. For the trials, you will have 10 seconds to begin typing your answer (the timer resets when you are typing). Hit ENTER after each response or when you don't have a good guess.

   If you get the fill-in-the-blank incorrect, you will have a 6-second required wait period to review the answer. If you are correct, the feedback will show for 1 second.

   After each training session, there will be a few questions about your thoughts on the training.

3. The second part comes 2 days later. You will get a posttest about what you learned (fill-in-the-blank items with feedback) and some survey questions about demographic information, anxiety survey, and the need for cognition survey.

Participating in this study is completely voluntary and if you decide to participate now, you may change your mind and stop at any point. You may choose not to answer any survey questions or do the training.

As a participant in this research study, you could acquire knowledge about Chinese character components. The results of this research could lead to suggestions for real-world implementation of adaptive training with optimal difficulty.

There are no foreseeable risks involved in participating in this study other than those encountered in day-to-day life.

By taking part in the research study you will be compensated. You will receive $12 after finishing the first part. There will also be a bonus of $.05 per correct answer in three sessions of training if you also complete the posttest. The bonus will be 10 or 15 dollars for most folks with moderate effort (e.g., 200 or 300 correct). When you come back 2 days later for the posttest, you will get the bonus plus an additional $5 for participation in the second part.

All efforts, within the limits allowed by law, will be made to keep the personal information (your Amazon Turk Worker ID) in your research record private, but total privacy cannot be promised. We will deidentify your data (remove your ID) after the experiment before storing it on our computers long-term. Because of privacy and confidentiality limitations associated with using MTurk IDs, we cannot guarantee complete anonymity. Worker IDs will only be used to distribute payment and will not be stored with survey responses. MTurk Worker IDs will not be shared with anyone. Further identifying information we gather (e.g. demographic information or IP addresses) will never be attached to your responses.

If you have questions about the research you may contact Meng Cao at 901-281-7348 or via email at mcao@memphis.edu and, or Philip Pavlik at 901-678-2326 or via email at ppavlik@memphis.edu. For questions regarding the research subjects' rights, the Chair of the Institutional Review Board for the Protection of Human Subjects should be contacted at 901.678.2705 or via email at irb@memphis.edu.

ELECTRONIC CONSENT

Please select your choice below. You may print a copy of this consent document for your records.

Clicking on the Continue button indicates that you

Have read the above information

Voluntarily agree to participate

Are 18 years of age or older

Here comes the first 15-minutes of training.

In this section, you will be given adaptive practice of Chinese character components at our highest difficulty which we hope will produce about 70% correct. Please do your best to learn the items and respond correctly so that we can understand if this level of difficulty/easiness works best to provide the optimal challenge for your learning.

In each trial, you will be given a Chinese character component, please type the corresponding English meaning. You have 6 seconds to start typing your answer. Hit ENTER after each response or when you don't have a good guess to get the 6-second review of the answer.

If you get the fill-in-the-blank incorrect, you will also have a 6-second review the answer. If you are correct, the feedback will show for only 1 second.
Here are 4 survey questions about the training you just experienced. Please read through each statement and select the option you agree most with.

Here comes the second 15-minutes of training.

In this section, you will be given adaptive practice of Chinese character components at our lowest difficulty which we hope will produce about 90% correct. Please do your best to learn the items and respond correctly so that we can understand if this level of difficulty/easiness works best to provide the optimal challenge for your learning.

In each trial, you will be given a Chinese character component, please type the corresponding English meaning. You have 6 seconds to start typing your answer. Hit ENTER after each response or when you don't have a good guess to get the 6-second review of the answer.

If you get the fill-in-the-blank incorrect, you will also have a 6-second review the answer. If you are correct, the feedback will show for only 1 second.
Here are 4 survey questions about the training you just experienced. Please read through each statement and select the option you agree most with.

Here comes the third 15-minutes of training.

In this section, you will be given adaptive practice of Chinese character components at our medium difficulty which we hope will produce about 80% correct. Please do your best to learn the items and respond correctly so that we can understand if this level of difficulty/easiness works best to provide the optimal challenge for your learning.

In each trial, you will be given a Chinese character component, please type the corresponding English meaning. You have 6 seconds to start typing your answer. Hit ENTER after each response or when you don't have a good guess to get the 6-second review of the answer.

If you get the fill-in-the-blank incorrect, you will also have a 6-second review the answer. If you are correct, the feedback will show for only 1 second.
Here are 4 survey questions about the training you just experienced. Please read through each statement and select the option you agree most with.
Now, based your three training sessions of experience overall, answer the following 3 learning method survey questions. Please read through each statement and select the option you agree most with.

Dear Amazon Turk Worker,
Recently you completed Part 1 of a 2-part experiment called 'Individual Differences in Optimal Learning', which paid $12.00. Now we would appreciate it if you would please return do Part 2. It is a bit less work than Part 1, we pay $5.00 for completion. Since it is so important for us to get the Part 2 data, we also pay extra bonus based on your correct answers in Part 1 ($.05 per correct answer, e.g., $10 for 200 answers) when you come back to finish Part 2. This must be completed 48 hours later when you get this email.
Please avoid typos in your Turk ID, since then we cannot identify you as a Part 2 person and cannot pay your bonus. You know you have continued correctly if it says 'Thanks for continuing. Here comes the posttest.'
Here is the link to finish: https://mofacts.optimallearning.org/experiment/indperiodic1
Thanks for your help,
Meng

Please enter the code- Ferrets -into the Amazon Mechanical Turk website for this HIT and submit your response now.

We will check your completion and approve your assignment for the $12 payment.

The countdown below is 2 days, you will receive a private Turk message (delivered to your email inbox) for instructions on Part 2. Part 2 earns a $5 bonus and extra bonus based on your correct answers in Part 1.

Thanks for continuing. Here comes the posttest.

There are 117 items you possibly learned in part 1. Given a Chinese character component, plese type the corresponding English meaning. The timing and feedback is the same as part 1.

Survey questions

Please answer the following 19 survey questions to complete the study.

Three of them are about demographic information.

Two of them are asking about your learning experience of the experiment material.

Ten of them are for anxiety test which can evaluate your test anxiety level based on your past testing experiences. You may wish to consider all testing experiences.

Four of them are about Need for Cognition which can measure your tendency to engage in and enjoy thinking.

To complete the survey, read through each statement and select one option that best describes you.
Your answers have been submitted. Thank you for participating in this challenging study of learning and assessment. Your account will be credited after we check your results.
